title: Vortex ring: vertical descent, recovery with collective only
flown: descent at zero ground speed flown by the autopilot until 1800 fpm or a developed ring (reached: -1522.399 fpm, ring depth 0.934); then collective +0.15 and held, the autopilot holding zero ground speed and heading with cyclic and pedals; 20 s from 4000 ft
